info.title: Open Giving SDK host API
info.description: Contract exposed by an adopter's host. The SDK operates no shared service; the host supplies authorization and provider adapters. Payment interfaces are optional, and native agent completion requires separate integration.

post.description: Pure public review-link preparation. No payment, reservation, session creation or authorization.
State-changing provider checkout preparation without a quote service. Not assumed idempotent; never retry ambiguous outcomes. Requires fresh donor approval; review final total before payment.

serviceBearer.description: Host-validated discovery or narrowly scoped guest/delegated credential. No SDK donor account is required. Discovery access does not authorize private gift operations.

checkoutPreparation.description: Whether the provider can create an existing checkout session without a quote API. This is a state-changing operation, not a confirmed payment.

amount.description: Provider-published need amount. Exact gifts use the full card value; partial providers can separately report the amount still needed.

amountRemaining.description: Provider-reported remaining amount in the same currency, no greater than amount. Omit when unknown; never infer partial progress.

updatedAt.description: Provider-reported update timestamp. Omit when unavailable; the request time is not an update timestamp.
